title: The Extremum Stack as Optimal Memory for Rate-Independent Sequence Models: Information-Theoretic Foundations and Online Complexity
summary: Rate-independent sequence models respond to the ordered structure of input extrema rather than to absolute timing or token position. This principle underlies Preisach Attention, a hysteretic alternative to softmax attention in which sequence history is represented by a stack of alternating extrema generated by the classical wiping-out rule. This paper establishes the information-theoretic and online algorithmic foundations of that representation.
